notablePrerequisites:
Dual Casting and Thornbite Staff attached to the same creature.
The creature with Dual Casting attached does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Force of Rage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Force of Rage.
Resolve the copy of Force of Rage, creating two  3/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Elemental, adding {R}.
The Elemental dies, triggering the creature with Thornbite Staff attached, untapping the creature.
Repeat from step 2 for an arbitrarily large number of creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Elementals, adding {2}.
Thornbite Staff triggers twice, untapping the equipped creature.
Activate the equipped creature by paying {2} and tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 7.
